scripts.text: Living in Midgard and away from
my home town is painful enough, let alone facing a whiny human. Leave me alone!
scripts.translation: 自己的家鄉之外已經夠痛苦了，還得面對愛抱怨的人類。別煩我！

scripts.text: Ask him what he is doing.
We're the toughest race. After all, we can live anywhere, no matter
scripts.translation: 我們是最堅韌的種族。無論

scripts.text: how harsh the environment may be.
scripts.translation: 環境多麼惡劣，我們都能生存。

scripts.text: I doubt your feeble mind can comprehend the how unendurable
scripts.translation: 我猜你那遲鈍的腦袋無法理解

scripts.text: it must be for you to live in my homeland, but you can try.
scripts.translation: 住在我的故鄉究竟有多難熬，
不過你可以試著想像一下。

scripts.text: Most of the knowledge and skills that you humans are so proud of were probably handed down from Dwarves.
scripts.translation: 你們人類引以為傲的大部分知識和技能，可能都是矮人傳授的。

scripts.text: This is especially true in the
case of smithing. Even the tools and weapons of the gods were made by my ancestors. You know that?
scripts.translation: 鍛造方面。就連眾神的工具和武器也是我的祖先打造的。你知道嗎？

scripts.text: We have the greatest knowlege and skills, but have accepted our fate to live in the cold, barren lands of the Giants.
scripts.translation: 我們擁有最淵博的知識和技藝，卻只能認命，住在巨人族那片寒冷貧瘠的土地上。

scripts.text: Did you just ask what I am doing here? Mwahahaha! Waiting for any humans stupid enough to come
scripts.translation: 你剛才是不是問我在這裡做什麼？哈哈哈！我在等那些蠢到敢來的

scripts.text: here so I can kick their ass!
scripts.translation: 人類，好讓我把他們揍一頓！

scripts.text: Oh don't worry. I'd only humiliate myself by fighting with a weakling like you. Humans are so fragile, but they stubbornly cling to their arrogance and fight amongst
scripts.translation: 別擔心。我才不屑和你這種弱者交手，免得自取其辱。人類如此脆弱，卻固執地抱著傲慢，彼此爭鬥

scripts.text: As a race, your people are just hopeless. I wouldn't even share the same continent with a human! But alas, I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 你們這個種族真是無可救藥。我一點也不想和人類住在同一片大陸上！可惜我別無選擇。

scripts.text: disappeared after the war 1,000 years ago. Somehow, I can no longer find the way through the Yggdrasil Tree that will take me back...
scripts.translation: 在一千年前的戰爭後消失了。不知為何，我再也找不到穿過世界樹回去的路...
我被困在米德加爾特了。

scripts.text: At least I was fortunate enough to find this cave. We Dwarves are most cozy living underground, after all.
scripts.translation: 至少我有幸找到這個洞穴。畢竟我們矮人最喜歡住在地下。

scripts.text: I'll need some things to make a weapon for you. What exactly were you interested in having?
scripts.translation: 我需要一些材料才能替你打造武器。你想要哪一件？

scripts.text: However, the time for me to create this Brisingamen has not yet come. You'll have to wait until the seals are released. Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation: 不過，現在還不是打造女神項鍊的時候。你必須等封印解除後再來。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: However, the seals on Megingjard have not yet been released. Until then, you'll have to wait! Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation: 不過雷神腰帶的封印還沒有解除。在那之前，你只能等著！哇哈哈！

scripts.text: But even so, I can't create Sleipnir until the seals have been broken. Otherwise, you're out of luck, human. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation: 即使如此，在封印解除之前我也無法打造史雷普尼爾。人類，想要就只能等。哈哈～！

scripts.text: But I can't even create a replica of Mjolnir if the seals are still in place. Until they're released, you'll just have to wait. Bwahaha!
scripts.translation: 不過只要封印還在，我連雷神之錘的仿製品都做不出來。等封印解除後再來。哇哈哈！

scripts.text: We Dwarves have too much pride to demonstrate our skills in front of a lowly human!
scripts.translation: 我們矮人可不屑在卑微的人類面前展示技藝！

scripts.text: Stop bothering me and get out of here! Go play with some monsters, you simple minded fool!
scripts.translation: 別來煩我，快滾出去！去找魔物玩吧，沒腦子的蠢貨！

scripts.translation: 這條項鍊只有戴在女神菲力亞身上才有意義。
